user.title: Task Manager Setup
user.description: Do you want to set up the Task Manager integration? Chores, gamification, and settings can be managed directly via the sidebar panel.

create_task.name: Create Task
create_task.description: Creates a new chore or task in Task Manager.

title.name: Title
title.description: The title or name of the task.

description.name: Description
description.description: Additional notes or instructions for the chore.

due_date.name: Due Date
due_date.description: Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today).

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Priority level (p1=Urgent, p2=High, p3=Medium, p4=Low, none=None).

assignee.name: Assignee User ID
assignee.description: ID of user to assign this chore to.

linked_thing_id.name: Linked Thing ID
linked_thing_id.description: ID of a Thing linked to this task (e.g. thing_water_filter).

complete_task.name: Complete Task
complete_task.description: Completes a task, awards points, rotates assignees, and calculates recurrence.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The unique identifier of the task.

task_title.name: Task Title
task_title.description: Find and complete the pending task matching this exact title.

user_id.name: Completed by User ID
user_id.description: User ID who gets credit and points (defaults to task's active assignee).

reset_task.name: Reset Task
reset_task.description: Resets a completed task back to pending.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The unique identifier of the task.

task_title.name: Task Title
task_title.description: The title of the task to reset.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The unique identifier of the task to delete.

update_thing.name: Update Thing
update_thing.description: Updates, increments, or resets a Thing counter or meter.

thing_id.name: Thing ID
thing_id.description: ID of the thing to update (e.g. thing_robot_dustbin).

delta.name: Delta Change
delta.description: Increment or decrement current value by this amount.

reset.name: Reset to Zero
reset.description: Reset the current value back to 0.

external_entity_id.name: External Entity ID
external_entity_id.description: Optional numeric Home Assistant entity to automatically sync from.

script_entity_id.name: Completion Script
script_entity_id.description: Optional Home Assistant script executed when completing a linked task.

increment_thing.name: Increment Thing
increment_thing.description: Increments or decrements a Thing's counter or meter value (especially for Things without a linked external entity).

entity_id.name: Entity / Sensor
entity_id.description: The sensor entity of the Thing (e.g. sensor.task_manager_thing_coffee_machine).

thing_id.name: Thing ID
thing_id.description: The unique identifier of the Thing (e.g. thing_coffee_machine).

amount.name: Amount / Step
amount.description: Amount to increment by (default: 1). Use negative numbers to decrement.

award_points.name: Award Points
award_points.description: Adjusts gamification points for a household member.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Note or reason for points adjustment.
